name: OPSD (Open Problem Self-Discovery)
description: Selects OpenThought-30k candidates with frozen LSC (Late Support Collapse) scores computed from privileged-context top-20 support overlap.
stopping_rule: six iterations; apply the previous-evaluation LSC threshold and select exactly 3200 rows from the fixed 6400-row pool

training_data.reference_context: first text-distinct rollout, fixed before labels are read

hyperparameters.threshold_strategy: derive cut from previous iteration evaluation, then retain exactly 3200 rows
